observations: No new photos were provided after the seller’s reply.
The original photos still only show the engine installed/laid out with DAF 24-valve text on the valve covers; no running/diagnostic evidence is shown.

claims.claim: Clean and powerful Trailer Head Engine, in excellent condition and ready for work.
claims.evidence: Seller text only; photos do not show leak test, compression, or running condition.
No performance test results or running video shown.
No import/shipping documents or serial/VIN plate photo shown.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No start-up video, no diagnostic scan/fault codes, no mileage/ECU readout, and no tamper evidence shown.

risks.risk: “Tested and working” may be untrue or intermittent; internal faults may not show without diagnostics/load.
risks.proof: Video of cold start + several minutes idle, plus a scanner screenshot showing no active fault codes.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst case: needs inspection/repairs).

risks.risk: “No knock” may be intermittent or only audible under load.
risks.proof: Video of the engine revving or running under light load with clear audio (front/side where noise would be heard).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possible internal noise/unknown wear.

risks.risk: “Never opened” and “low mileage” cannot be verified from photos; could be rebuilt or worn.
risks.proof: Close-ups of seals/gaskets and any tamper evidence; photo of engine serial/engine code plate and any service records.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown history (worst case: may have been opened/repaired).

risks.risk: Exact variant/spec is unclear; wrong variant affects parts compatibility and price.
risks.proof: Photo of the engine ID/serial plate (engine code) and any stamped part numbers; ECU label photo.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest compatible assumption for a DAF 24-valve trailer head engine.

risks.risk: Completeness/accessories may be missing or damaged (sensors, fuel lines, turbo hoses, wiring connectors).
risks.proof: Inventory photos of all sides (front/rear/left/right) and close-ups of fuel system connections, sensor plugs, turbo inlet/outlet, and all belts/hoses.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially incomplete/unknown accessory condition.

proof_requests: Please send the engine ID/serial plate photo (engine code) and any stamped numbers so the exact DAF variant is confirmed.
Send a start-up video (cold start if possible) with clear audio and no warning lights.
Send an ECU diagnostic screenshot/report showing fault codes (or “no active faults”).
Send close-ups of seals/gaskets/tamper evidence to support “never opened.”
Send photos of all sides and a quick parts checklist to confirm completeness.
response.reason: The seller insists the claims are true, but without new photos or diagnostic/running evidence, the key factors that determine price (verified working status, no-knock confirmation, mileage/history, and exact variant/completeness) remain unprovable remotely.
